verdict.rationale: Ghostty's docs say it supports multiple windows, each with its own tabs and splits, rendered with native UI components. GitHub adds tab renaming and coloring, and the AppleScript dictionary can script windows, tabs and layouts. So panes and tabs are built in, with no external multiplexer needed. Missing for 10: detailed docs on creating, navigating and resizing splits; any detach or session-persistence equivalent to a multiplexer; independent hands-on confirmation of split and tab workflows.
